note: Ps46 God-our-refuge (corrected method; sharp drop-off). Human IB = 3: yare not-fear (grounded in God-refuge), samach the city made glad, yada be-still-and-know. ~8 God-attributes/acts (refuge/strength/help/fortress/breaks-bow/exalted) = qualifiers. Cosmic imagery (sea's heart, surging, melting earth, desolations, holy place) = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: grounded in God our refuge and strength (v1)

'Therefore we will not FEAR (yare), though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the sea' — fearlessness even at cosmic collapse; yare negated, the confidence grounded not in stability but in God as refuge and strength (v1 = the qualifier) — faith unshaken though creation shakes
make glad / rejoice (samach - the city of God)
God's help and presence in her midst (v5)

'There is a river whose streams make GLAD (samach) the city of God' — the settled joy of God's dwelling amid raging waters; samach here the gladness of the secure city, made glad by the quiet river of God's presence (his help in her midst = the qualifier) — peace at the centre of chaos
know (yada - know that I am God)
grounded in God's exaltation over the nations (v10)

'Be still, and KNOW (yada) that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations' — the command to cease striving and recognise God's supremacy; yada here the quiet, submissive knowledge of God's sovereignty (his being exalted = the qualifier) — the inner stillness that answers the raging nations, the psalm's summit
refuge / shelter (machaseh - God is our refuge)
the refuge grounding the people's fearlessness (v1->v2)

v1 QUALIFIER (God as refuge): 'God is our REFUGE (machaseh) and strength, a very present help in trouble' - God-as-refuge is not a human IB char; it is the source grounding the people's not-fearing (279047). Qualifier.
the strength grounding the people's fearlessness (v1->v2)
v1 QUALIFIER (God as strength): 'God is our refuge and STRENGTH (oz)' - God-as-strength is not a human IB char; the source of the people's confidence (279047). Qualifier.
God's help making the city glad and unmoved (v5->v4)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'God is in the midst of her... God will HELP (azar) her when morning dawns' - God's help is not a human IB char; the source of the city's gladness and security (279063). Qualifier.
fortress / high stronghold (misgab - God our fortress)
the stronghold grounding the people's fearlessness (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God as fortress): 'The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our FORTRESS (misgab)' - God-as-fortress is not a human IB char; the refrain-source of the people's confidence (279047). Qualifier.
break / shatter (shabar - God breaks the bow)
God's war-ending works grounding the call to know him (v9->v10)

v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'He makes wars cease... he BREAKS (shabar) the bow and shatters the spear' - God's disarming of the earth is not a human IB char; the work that grounds 'be still and know that I am God' (279031). Qualifier.
be exalted (rum - I will be exalted among the nations)
God's exaltation, the content of the knowing (v10)
v10 QUALIFIER (God's exaltation): 'I will be EXALTED (rum) among the nations' - God's self-exaltation is not a human IB char; it is what the stilled people are to know (279031). Qualifier.
be exalted (rum - I will be exalted in the earth)
God's exaltation, the content of the knowing (v10)
v10 QUALIFIER (God's exaltation, repeated): 'I will be EXALTED (rum) in the earth!' - God's supremacy is not a human IB char; the object of the knowing (279031). Qualifier.
the stronghold grounding the people's fearlessness (v11)

v11 QUALIFIER (God as fortress, refrain): 'The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our FORTRESS (misgab)' - God-as-fortress is not a human IB char; the repeated refrain-source of confidence (279047). Qualifier.
heart / midst (lev - heart of the sea)
v2: 'though the mountains be moved into the HEART (lev) of the sea' - lev here the midst/depth of the sea (an idiom for the sea's middle), a physical location, not an inner operation. Standalone.

v3: 'though the mountains tremble at its SWELLING (gaavah)' - gaavah here the surging/rising of the sea's waters (its 'majesty' as a wave), a physical convulsion, not a human inner operation. Standalone.
holy (qadosh - the holy habitation of the Most High)
v4: 'the HOLY (qadosh) habitation of the Most High' - the holiness of God's dwelling-place; an attribute of the place, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v6: 'he utters his voice, the earth MELTS (mug)' - the earth dissolving at God's voice; a cosmic effect of the divine word, not a human inner operation. Standalone.

v8: 'behold the works of the LORD, how he has brought DESOLATIONS (shammah) on the earth' - the ruins God works; the outward effects of divine judgement (God's deeds), not a human inner operation. Standalone.
